Fixes #(issue)

## 🔍 Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance optimization
- [ ] 🛡️ Security patch
- [ ] 🎨 UI/UX enhancement
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update
- [ ] 🔧 Refactoring / Code cleanup
- [ ] 🧪 Tests / CI-CD update

## 🧪 Testing Checklist
- [ ] Tested on **Windows** (10 / 11)
- [ ] Tested on **Linux** (Ubuntu / Arch / Debian / Fedora)
- [ ] Tested on **macOS** (Intel / Apple Silicon)
- [ ] Verified build succeeds (`wails build -clean`)
- [ ] Verified tests pass (`go test ./...`)
- [ ] Verified dual language support (EN / FA) and RTL layout

---

## 📊 Evidence

House rule 2 is *measure, do not assume* — a plausible theory is not evidence.
Tick exactly one:

- [ ] **Bug fix** — I have included before/after evidence: a failing test, a log
      excerpt, or the command output that demonstrated the problem.
- [ ] **Performance / reliability claim** — I have included the numbers and how
      they were measured.
- [ ] **Neither** — this is a documentation, refactor, or UI-only change.
